note: Moony FFlag presets. Only flags on Roblox's launcher allowlist are used, so every one of these actually applies.

presets.name: Max FPS
presets.desc: Raises the frame cap to 240 and turns off the heaviest extras.

presets.name: Potato PC
presets.desc: Lowest textures, no grass, low-detail models and a flat sky. For old laptops.

presets.name: Competitive
presets.desc: No grass, no anti-aliasing and a 240 FPS cap. Cleaner view, faster frames.

presets.name: Crisp visuals
presets.desc: Highest textures and 4x anti-aliasing for smooth edges.

presets.name: Ultra anti-aliasing
presets.desc: 8x MSAA. Very smooth edges, needs a strong GPU.

presets.name: Vulkan
presets.desc: Use Vulkan. Can be smoother on some AMD and NVIDIA cards.

presets.name: DirectX 11
presets.desc: Force DirectX 11. The most compatible choice.

presets.name: OpenGL
presets.desc: Use OpenGL. Helps on a few older Intel GPUs.

presets.name: Gray sky
presets.desc: Swaps the skybox for flat gray. Small FPS boost.

presets.name: Sharp UI
presets.desc: Turns off DPI scaling for crisper UI on high-DPI screens.

presets.name: Real fullscreen
presets.desc: Alt+Enter uses exclusive fullscreen instead of a borderless window.
